payload.rationale: This document is a Phase 2 E2E test reproducing the missing-id failure pattern — a markdown heading submitted without an explicit id field, requiring the pipeline to derive a slug and commit without crashing. The graph's active narrative (Narrative_ContentDerivedSlugResolution) and its unplaced position (Position_SubmissionWithoutExplicitIdHandling) are the exact frame this document extends: both ask how the pipeline handles omitted identifiers and commits content. The source sample (Sample_1SampleMemoryWithDistinctiveHeading) and its two expressions — the claim that content was submitted without an id, and the decision that the pipeline must produce a slug via LLM id-gen or deterministic slugify fallback — are the witnessed material this document reproduces and validates. I did not expand the DiagnosticFirst decision or the People/Unplaced doors because they concern engagement methodology and actor identity, not the slug-derivation pipeline behavior this document tests.
